# Core pain.

## Classification by operational value

| scene | Typical problem. | Main roles | Main value | Demand characteristics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AI Summary of meetings | Time-consuming records, unclear conclusions, lost tasks | Administration, project manager, HF participants | Savings in time and savings | It's easier to experience, with more alternatives of the same kind. |
| Sales growth | Clients scattered, follow-up untransparent, unpredictable. | Sales Director, Manager | Customer asset deposition, conversion and forecasting | Closely related to CRM usage and data quality |
| Procurement management | The price is low, the suppliers are difficult to evaluate, the budget is out of control. | Procurement, finance, managers | Reductions, synergies and compliance | Suitable for multi-supplier and high-frequency procurement organizations |
| Stock and sale | Inconsistencies, missing items, slow maintenance response | Storage, after sale, operation | Working capital, delivery and client services | Related to worksheets, material and inventory connection |
| Cross-sectoral approval | Slow processes, duplication of data, lack of accountability | Financial, administrative, management | Efficiency and internal control | Value depends on cross-sectoral flow |
| Personnel and finance automation | Recruitment, attendance, remuneration, manual processing of vouchers | HR, Finance | Saving people and reducing errors | Higher standardization and maturity of the same product |
| Operating the cockpit. | Different data calibres, delays in reporting | Corporate managers, managers of operations | Decision-making speed and business visualization | Dependence on master data quality and system integration |
| Conference on Privatization Security | Sensitive content is not suitable for the use of generic public clouds. | IT, legal, organizational manager | Risk control and compliance | Focus on deployment, security and auditing |
| Visualizing configuration application setup | Demand, IT, long schedule, traditional costs High | IT, Operations | Agility and reduced development costs | Need for authority, version and application governance |
| Multilingual/cross-regional collaboration | Languages, time zones, weak webs, inconsistent documents | Cross-border operations, regional directors | Delivery and collaboration | Conference and business systems portfolio needs are evident |
